verdict.rationale: The Kimi API Platform publishes a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1.0 document covering chat completions, responses, Anthropic-compatible messages, batches, files, and models. It also publishes a separate OpenAPI 3.0.3 Admin API spec, and both download without authentication. The specs belong to the platform.kimi.ai developer product, which the vendor distinguishes from the consumer assistant app; the probe found no public API for the assistant itself. Missing for 10: a spec covering the Kimi assistant app or Kimi Code surfaces, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the specs download and validate.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
